verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB lets users turn any SQL query into a monitored rule with an operator, threshold, interval, severity and templates (docs-21). These rules fire automatically to reusable Slack and HTTP webhook destinations (docs-22), so rule-based automatic actions are delivered at the core. Materialized views also run transformations automatically on insert events (docs-34, docs-36). missing for 10: event triggers beyond interval-polled threshold checks, action types beyond notifications/webhooks (e.g. running SQL or jobs on trigger), in-depth docs on rule behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
